title: @bsh/blockspace-certify environment
description: Parsed by src/config.ts, which reports every problem at once and exits 2. Secrets are injected from the secret store; the paths are listed in component.yaml.

HOST.description: Bind address. Use 0.0.0.0 behind the edge proxy.

CERTIFY_ORD_URL.description: ord server base URL (JSON API enabled). Required unless CERTIFY_ORD=fake.

CERTIFY_ORD.description: Dev only (needs CERTIFY_DEV=1): use the in-memory FakeOrd.

CERTIFY_ORD_CHILDREN_PATH.description: Which ord route lists children as JSON.

CERTIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for POST /v1/collections/{slug}/refresh. Secret: services/blockspace-certify/admin-token.

CERTIFY_SIGNING_KEY.description: secp256k1 secret key (hex) that signs attestations. Secret: services/blockspace-certify/attestation-key. Required unless CERTIFY_DEV=1 (ephemeral key).

CERTIFY_COLLECTIONS_FILE.description: Path to the collections JSON (see config/collections.example.json). Manifest paths inside it resolve relative to this file.

CERTIFY_CONCURRENCY.description: Parallel ord requests during a refresh (1..64).

CERTIFY_DEV.description: Allows the fake ord and an ephemeral signing key. Never set in production.
